title: BreakdownStep
description: One step of the per-intermediate-version breakdown of a cumulative offer (RF-050): the summary of one consecutive pair of [currentVersion, intermediateVersions..., offerTarget] (DISENO 3.8.6).
$comment: Source: DISENO 3.8.6 (BreakdownStep), S7 (e) GET /v1/engagements/{id}/pending-update/breakdown, DEC-34; PRD RF-050. Audience: public (S7). Residency: global non-confidential summary content cached in the cell.

fromVersion.description: Base version of the step (version label).

toVersion.description: Target version of the step (version label).

summaryStatus.description: As in PendingUpdateView, plus PENDING while the step summary is generated (S7 then sends GenerateChangeSummary.v1).

record.description: Summary of the step; null unless AVAILABLE or CACHED.
